Registered photo RMS / maximum: 5.504 / 19.714 px. Actual plumb build RMS / maximum: 5.776 / 24.689 px. Plumb edge median / p95 / maximum: 5.847 / 19.827 / 32.619 mm. Calibrated views: f2164, f3279, f3788, f4974.

The follow-up supersedes the old 105° collision-free and nominal-depth requirements. Each door is tested in the WORLD assembly with other fronts closed, at 0.25° steps through 107°, followed by 20 bisection iterations at first contact. Installed range = min(105°, first contact − 2°). Contact uses zero penetration threshold; simulator validation permits only 0.02 mm mesh roundoff. All contact masks remain enabled. These are conservative geometric stops, not independently measured hardware stops. A no-contact door keeps 105° and explicitly records that cap as its reason.

No door with first contact below 80° is accepted automatically: fit_limits.py stops for an evidence review. An initial plumb-build sweep found the right sink door touching the microwave countertop at 0°. Its hinge side/front centre were rechecked against articulation, joint_states and f3684/f3666/f3736; the two connected L-counter slabs had been levelled to different heights. They now share one horizontal level, with the rear base support extended to meet it. Hinge side and front centre are unchanged. See review/fit_sub80_evidence_review.json and the retained initial-contact report. The final sweep's minimum contact is 84.6528°. q_open_frames, source articulation and joint_states evidence remain unchanged. All original hinge sides were retained after the corrected construction passed this gate.

Individual stops do not make arbitrary simultaneous L-corner motion feasible. 8 pairs have sampled interfering combinations; the full contacts and angles remain in fit_report.json under coordinated-access diagnostics. Open one obstructing door at a time; the physical contact geometry remains active. Fully-open review renders show all installed maxima together and may therefore contain these expected door-door collisions.

Depth acceptance uses calibrated multiview registration: **per-front rms edge offset ≤10 px**, in the original **640×854 annotation/review images**. This statistic is an explicit interpretation of the unspecified aggregate, not a claim that every point is within 10 px: retained registration has individual samples up to 19.714 px (prep) and 13.611 px (rear). Reports include every signed sample, median, RMS, p95, maximum and full-resolution 1280×1707 pixel offsets. No image, annotation or threshold was rescaled to obtain a pass. This is an image-space fit criterion, not a 10 mm accuracy claim. Actual front-to-back depths replace generic nominal depths. Hidden backs still depend on the supplied room geometry. The shorter hood and projecting refrigerator upper are retained.

The capture construction frame is tilted 2.34098° from WORLD up. The rebuilt frame retains yaw only. Every front is plumb about its unchanged measured WORLD centre; boxes have vertical edges and horizontal tops, and counters are horizontal. To preserve 3 mm seams with these fixed centres, front widths change by at most 12.623 mm. Frame packing seats each front 1 mm ahead of its own opening; hidden cases remain rectangular. The small remaining steps in centre heights/depths follow the measured centres in the tilted WORLD frame.

The photo report separates the retained calibrated registration from the actual plumb build. Their difference is the deliberately removed WORLD-frame tilt (plus the documented seam corrections); pre-existing registration residuals remain visible. A separate job will correct the WORLD frame against the photos. No camera or upstream measurement file was changed here.

All 18 openings retain 15 mm overlays. Drawer fronts and complete 500 mm boxes are single rigid bodies with 450 mm travel. Counter supports meet their horizontal slabs. All existing texture file hashes are unchanged. The left sink outer extent is cropped and symmetry-completed; right-dish closed extent is constrained by its sibling because its old closed annotations depict an open leaf. Hidden joinery, shelves, mass, friction, damping and the rigid ribbon approximation remain estimates. This is sampled kinematic validation, not a continuous-motion proof or robot manipulation validation; other asset sets are excluded.

Reproduce with `nice -n 19 taskset -c 16-19 [source workspace] fit_rebuild.py` from this set's parent directory. CPU only, four cores. See ../review/fit_artifact_manifest.json for hashes and ../review/fit_followup_before/ for the prior state.
